overview: The CC Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board reviewed proposed zoning ordinance language regarding fractional inclusionary housing payments and received updates on funding requests, property developments, and revenue generation. The board voted to submit a letter supporting the fractional payment ordinance and directed staff to apply for technical assistance focused on voluntary fundraising.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the minutes from the November 5 meeting.

items.title: Fractional Payment Ordinance
items.summary: Staff presented proposed ordinance language allowing cash payments for fractional affordable unit requirements, and the board voted to submit a letter supporting the proposal with minor edits.

items.title: CPC Funding Request Update
items.summary: Staff and members reviewed the trust's presentation requesting $550,000 from the Community Preservation Committee, noting that funding deliberations will occur the following week.

items.title: Action Plan Presentation to City Council Update
items.summary: Trustees summarized their presentation of the five-year action plan to the City Council and discussed strategies to expand community outreach for future surveys.

items.title: 703 Fellsway West Development Update
items.summary: Staff reported that certificates of occupancy have been issued for 703 Fellsway West and announced a ribbon-cutting ceremony scheduled for December 18.

items.title: Increasing Affordable Housing Trust Fund Revenue
items.summary: The board discussed resident donation inquiries and incoming revenue streams, and agreed to have staff draft an application for MHP technical assistance focused on voluntary fundraising.
